notes: Value = rent per m² of lettable floor per MONTH, in the source's currency, ex-VAT, net of service charge unless stated (US / Canada NNN net).
Prime = top headline rent for a modern unit in the best location; average = market-wide asking. Each item's scope says which. A supplier outside prime rings typically pays 10–25% below prime.
Conversions: 1 m² = 10.7639 sq ft; 1 tsubo = 1 ping = 1 pyeong = 3.30579 m²; per-year figures ÷ 12.
